notes.title: Free Content Update - Shadows in Duan’s Mansion Now Available
notes.notes: [p]\[list]\[*]New areas of YinYang Street are added, along with different functional NPCs.[/p][p]\[list]\[*]Changle Lane with Sky Fox, where you can play mahjong.[/p][p]\[*]Fractured Dreams, where you can recall part of Minglai’s memories.[/p][p]\[*]Ingenuity, where you can play a couple of rewarding mini games.[/p][p]\[*]Knowing-all, where you can buy intelligence and exorcism items.[/p][p]\[*]Sky Lock, where you can renovate areas of Duan’s Mansion to unlock their functions, for example, you can rebuild the cloth dyeing area to unlock the feature of tie-dyeing.\[/list][/p][p]\[*]Duan’s Mansion can be explored freely. You need to buy specific exorcism items at YinYang Street, exorcise evil spirits resident in Duan’s Mansion, renovate the mansion and bring it back to its heyday. Dark secrets are waiting for you to uncover, including the taboo sealed by Duan Clan for thousands of years and the true identity of Hermit Xiayun.\[/list][/p][p]To show gratitude to everyone who supports us, we make this major content update with brand-new gameplay, and we hope each of you will enjoy it. If you have any suggestion or doubt, please post it in Steam Discussion.[/p][p]Thanks again for everyone’s continuous support. We will keep learning, keep improving ourselves, and present higher-quality games to people who like our franchise.[/p]

notes.title: 《街漓芳传》后续更新计划公布
notes.notes:
《街漓芳传》上线之后我们收到了很多UU反馈的剧情和内容方面的问题，为使每一位购买了我们游戏的玩家能有更完整的游戏体验，我们决定将填充更细节的游戏剧情内容，以及更多的游戏玩法，具体更新计划如下：
1.新增优化第二章的剧情内容，使剧情衔接更为顺畅合理。
2.游戏通关后开放阴阳街新增区域与对应功能NPC
（1）.天狐，长乐坊赌场，可游玩新的赌博游戏；
（2）.忆梦，可通过李明来意识残留的回忆，窥探李明来视角的部分剧情；
（3）.巧家，可从此NPC处进行游玩有奖挑战关卡制小游戏集；
（4）.晓百事商店开放，可购买部分情报和驱灵道具；
（5）.天锁处解锁段家大宅翻新功能，重建段宅并解锁部分特定功能，如重建染制区以获得染制扎染的区域功能。
3.游戏通关后开放段氏大宅自由探索地图，玩家需从阴阳街购买对应驱灵道具，扫除残留在段氏大宅的厉鬼冤魂，重建残破的大宅恢复往日风采。并寻找各个隐藏在黑暗角落里的秘密，探究段氏一族深藏千年的禁忌，以及霞云居士的真实身份和目的。
并且我们已确认参展6月29号的核聚变活动，内容更新计划于核聚变活动期间上线，各位UU记得关注我们的动态更新获取最新消息。最后再次感谢各位街友的支持，我们会尽最大的可能进行内容优化更新~

notes.title: Small update on June 3rd
notes.notes:
1. Added the function of saving the game as another file, allowing you to overwrite an existing save or create a new one.
2. Added a position correction feature. You can use it by clicking on the backpack when it's open to return to a normal position from an abnormal one.
3. Fixed issues with the rewind interface.
4. Optimized some UI display problems in the controller mode.
5. Optimized some process-related issues.
6. Fixed the problem where the game would freeze with a certain probability after death.
7. Added gameplay tips for the Ghost Road.
8. Fixed some known localization display issues.

notes.title: Update Notes for May 30th
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that prevented the game from continuing due to missing negatives.
2. Fixed display and operation bugs at 4K resolution.
3. Optimized display issues in some scenes.
4. Optimized the display of some UI elements in controller mode.
5. Modified display bugs in foreign languages.

notes.title: YinYang Street: Separate Ways coming May 29!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45465384/c17d3f54638e44757813d69ec8c5bb56d19c4a54.png[/img]
YinYang Street: Separate Ways is coming to Steam on May 29th, 2025 with a 10% launch week discount. It’s also coming to Sony PlayStation, Nintendo Switch and other possible consoles this summer. We truly appreciate our fans’ support, without which we couldn’t have made it this far.

Do not look back if you hear my voice from behind, my beloved husband.
There is no turning back at the other side of the Naihe Bridge.

In YinYang Street: Separate Ways, you’ll play the role of Duan Lifang from Duan Clan, unveil a mystery that traces back to one thousand years ago, feel the separation between the loved ones in life and death, and reminisce about those revolutionary martyrs who died for justice. Let’s face people’s predicament in the 1980s, and challenge the unfair fate bravely!
